sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Farha Taj.

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 06-07-2020 and at the time of the marriage as per the demands of the accused the parent's of CW1 had given gold ornaments and household things at the time of the marriage.

After the marriage accused had subjected CW1 to mental and physical cruelty by harassing CW1 to bring more dowry fro her parent's, abusing her, assaulting her,
telling her not to go to her parent's house until she brings dowry,
did not take care of her when she was pregnant. Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.53/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Womens P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance  3  C.C.No.33426/2021 and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.

sentences.text: Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

Statement of the accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C., was recorded and the accused has denied all the incriminating evidence found in the evidence and stated he has no defence evidence and nothing to say.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused caused physical and mental  4  C.C.No.33426/2021  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry and  threatened her and thereby accused have committed the  offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry  Prohibition Act..?
2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

3  10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Farah Taj.

sentences.text:
She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 06-07-2020 and deposed after the marriage,
they lived a happy life for about a week only.
She has also deposed that the accused used to harass her in respect of getting additional dowry and used to sexually abuse her.
She has also deposed that on 11-11-2020 when she had gone to see her parent's at that time  5  C.C.No.33426/2021 the accused called her and told her to come to his house within half an hour.
She has deposed that as she was late to come the accused had quarelled with her.
She has also deposed that the accused used to torture her to get gold ornaments.

However, during her cross examination she has turned completely hostile to the case of the prosecution and deposed that accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused,
assaulted her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
She has denied giving complaint as per Ex-P1 and also denied the police conducting mahazar as per Ex-P2.

She admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and they have already taken Khula (divorce).
 11.
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.

Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon Farha Taj vs Auub Baig on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196236316/
4 other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also  6  C.C.No.33426/2021 the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified,
corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 08-10-2025).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ACJM., BENGALURU.
